title: VampPrior Unleashed
abstract: arXiv:2610.27322v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep latent variable models (DLVMs) underpin many modern analysis pipelines, for example in single-cell genomics, yet their prior distributions have received markedly little attention. The VampPrior approximates the optimal prior (the aggregate posterior) and often attains high model evidence. Here, we identify two key limitations of the VampPrior: it ties prior and posterior uncertainty to a single amortized covariance and clusters poorly due to its fixed uniform mixture weights. We unleash the VampPrior by decoupling its prior and posterior covariances, resolving the conflict of generating high prior and low posterior entropy with the same shared parameters and substantially improving model evidence. We then replace the uniform mixture with a Dirichlet process. When combined, our proposals provide higher model evidence than the VampPrior and robust non-parametric clustering. translated_abstract: 深度潜变量模型（DLVMs）支撑着许多现代分析流程，例如在单细胞基因组学中，但其先验分布却鲜受关注。VampPrior近似最优先验（聚合后验），通常能获得较高的模型证据。在此，我们识别出VampPrior的两个关键局限：它将先验与后验的不确定性绑定在同一个摊销协方差上，并且由于其固定的均匀混合权重而导致聚类效果不佳。我们通过解耦先验与后验协方差来释放VampPrior的潜力，解决了用同一组共享参数同时产生高先验熵和低后验熵的冲突，并显著提升了模型证据。随后，我们用狄利克雷过程取代均匀混合。两者结合后，我们的方法相比VampPrior提供了更高的模型证据以及稳健的非参数聚类。将我们的[方法]与单细胞变分推断（scVI）相结合……
tldr: 该论文通过解耦VampPrior的先验与后验协方差，并用狄利克雷过程取代固定的均匀混合权重，显著提升了模型证据并实现了稳健的非参数聚类。
en_tdlr: This paper unleashes the VampPrior by decoupling its prior and posterior covariances and replacing uniform mixture weights with a Dirichlet process, substantially improving model evidence and enabling robust non-parametric clustering.
